name: Kyrgyz Som Stablecoin
oneLiner: KGST is a Kyrgyz som-pegged stablecoin claiming 1:1 KGS bank reserves; no public attestation cadence has been verified.
collateral: Kyrgyz som fiat reserves and cash equivalents held in licensed banks and custodial institutions to back KGST 1:1 against the Kyrgyz som
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption route designed to maintain 1 KGST = 1 KGS through fully backed som reserves

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: KGST's issuer disclosure identifies a 1:1 Kyrgyz-som token backed by KGS cash or cash equivalents held with licensed Kyrgyz banks and custodial institutions. That supports the fiat-cash archetype while leaving the issuer's unverified reserve composition and assurance claims in the separate reserve review.

jurisdiction.regulator: State Service for Regulation and Supervision of the Financial Market

sources.label: KGST owner Safe (token owner / freeze authority)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: 2026-07-30 re-review of KGST holder freeze/blacklist posture. Sole tracked deployment is BSC proxy 0x94be0bba8e1e303fe998c9360b57b826f1a4f828. At BSC block 113079584, EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xa903a6c1c3bd45927542823528a6fa73a2a410e2 and admin slot to ProxyAdmin 0xcb628ce396f8f6ffbfae48721fe02a668a9a718b; token owner() returned 2-of-5 Safe 0xb94f9247bd181fc9aca4d8694fb3774ed99be5d5. Sourcify exact-matches the implementation as Stablecoin (ERC20PermitUpgradeable + Ownable2StepUpgradeable + PausableUpgradeable). Source exposes owner-only freeze(address)/unfreeze(address) over mapping frozen, owner-only pause()/unpause(), and _transfer/_approve overrides that require whenNotPaused and notFrozen(from/to). That is a direct individual holder freeze plus system-wide pause on the sole material deployment. paused() read false at the observation block. Issuer site confirms a centralized, regulator-supervised KGSToken LLC issuance model consistent with privileged admin controls. Conclusion: canBeBlacklisted=true (reach individual; pause also system-wide).

params.label: Kyrgyz som fiat reserves and cash equivalents

mintAuthority.summary: KGST's sole BSC deployment is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy. The token owner and the owner of ProxyAdmin 0xcb628ce396f8f6ffbfae48721fe02a668a9a718b are both the same immediate 2-of-5 Safe at 0xb94f9247bd181fc9aca4d8694fb3774ed99be5d5. Stablecoin.mint(uint256) has no supply cap and mints to the owner caller. The Safe has no modules, guard, module guard, or timelock.

controls.capDescription: Stablecoin.mint(uint256) has no supply ceiling and mints the requested amount to the owner caller.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 109812367, token owner() and ProxyAdmin.owner() both returned 0xb94f9247bd181fc9aca4d8694fb3774ed99be5d5; token pendingOwner() was zero. The Safe returned five owners, threshold 2, VERSION 1.4.1, no enabled modules, zero guard and module-guard slots, standard fallback handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, and singleton 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762.

review.evidence: At BSC block 109812367, KGST proxy 0x94be0bba8e1e303fe998c9360b57b826f1a4f828 used implementation 0xa903a6c1c3bd45927542823528a6fa73a2a410e2 and ProxyAdmin 0xcb628ce396f8f6ffbfae48721fe02a668a9a718b. Token owner and ProxyAdmin owner both resolved to immediate 2-of-5 Safe 0xb94f9247bd181fc9aca4d8694fb3774ed99be5d5. The Safe was version 1.4.1 with no modules, guard, module guard, or timelock. Stablecoin.mint(uint256) had no supply ceiling. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No independent attestor, recurring cadence, or dated KGST reserve-to-liability report was located. Kyrgyzstan's Financial Market Regulation and Supervision Service records an exact match for LLC KGSToken's first public KGST stablecoin issuance, providing registry-backed issuer supervision but not independent reconciliation.
